description: This file defines the `ModifySubjectsResponse` class, a JSON-serializable response object for a `ModifySubjects` command in the Eclipse Ditto project. It encapsulates details such as policy ID and label, and provides methods for creation from JSON and for accessing relevant response information.

classes.name: ModifySubjectsResponse
classes.description: Immutable response class for ModifySubjects command, provides JSON serialization/deserialization, accessors for policy ID and label, and overrides methods for object comparison and string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a ModifySubjectsResponse using typed PolicyId. Deprecated version accepts String policy ID.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or JsonObject, parsing policy ID and label, along with status code and headers.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this response.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry whose subjects were modified.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path representing the resource location of this response.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Builds the JSON payload for this response, including policy ID and label.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new response instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality, considering policy ID and label.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code based on superclass, policy ID, and label.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object including class name, superclass info, policy ID, and label.
